segments.tha-ap52:11.3: Hiraññaṃ tassa [hiraññassa ca (sī. ka.)] nicitaṃ, koṭisatamanappakaṃ.
segments.tha-ap52:12.3: Vaṅgantassa suto dhīmā, sāriyā oraso piyo.
segments.tha-ap52:16.1: “Bhātaraṃ me upaṭṭhitvā, dhātuṃ pattamhi ohiya [opiya (sī.), ociya (syā.)];
segments.tha-ap52:19.1: “Paṭisambhidānuppattā, vimokkhāpi ca phassitā [paṭisambhidā catasso, vimokkhāpi ca aṭṭhime (syā.)];
segments.tha-ap52:20.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā cundo thero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthāti.
segments.tha-ap52:24.5: Gāthāsataṃ satālīsaṃ [ca tālīsaṃ (sī. syā.)], catasso ca taduttari.

lines: So pattaarahattaphalo ekadivasaṃ attano pubbakammaṃ saritvā somanassajāto pubbacaritāpadānaṃ pakāsento siddhatthassa bhagavatotiādimāha.
Vitiṇṇakaṅkho sambuddhoti visesena maggādhigamena vicikicchāya khepitattā vitiṇṇakaṅkho asaṃsayo sambuddho.
Tiṇṇoghehi purakkhatoti kāmoghādīnaṃ catunnaṃ oghānaṃ tiṇṇattā atikkantattā oghatiṇṇehi khīṇāsavehi purakkhato parivāritoti attho.

Upaṭṭhahiṃ mahāvīranti uttamatthassa nibbānassa pattiyā pāpuṇanatthāya kappasatasahassādhikesu caturāsaṅkhyeyyesu kappesu pāramiyo pūrentena katavīriyattā mahāvīraṃ buddhaṃ upaṭṭhahiṃ upaṭṭhānaṃ akāsinti attho.
Aññe ca pesale bahūti na kevalameva buddhaṃ upaṭṭhahiṃ, pesale piyasīle sīlavante aññe ca bahuaggappatte sāvake, me mayhaṃ bhātaraṃ sāriputtattherañca upaṭṭhahinti sambandho.

Bhātaraṃ me upaṭṭhahitvāti mayhaṃ bhātaraṃ upaṭṭhahitvā vattapaṭivattaṃ katvā tassa parinibbutakāle bhagavato paṭhamaṃ parinibbutattā tassa dhātuyo gahetvā pattamhi okiritvā lokajeṭṭhassa narānaṃ āsabhassa buddhassa upanāmesiṃ adāsinti attho.
Ubho hatthehi paggayhāti taṃ mahā dinnaṃ dhātuṃ so bhagavā attano ubhohi hatthehi pakārena gahetvā taṃ dhātuṃ saṃsuṭṭhu dassayanto aggasāvakaṃ sāriputtattheraṃ kittayi pakāsesīti attho.
